assertions.assertion: The patient presents with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient reports recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient had one recent event of syncope
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for further diagnostic assessment
The diagnosis codes I48.0, R42, and R55 support the clinical picture of atrial fibrillation with associated symptoms
The CPT 93271 service is medically necessary to document whether the patient's dizziness, giddiness, and syncope are related to underlying arrhythmia
The appeal requests reconsideration of the PR-204 denial
